finding: Most pelvic floor dysfunction (PFD) present at 1 year postpartum was found to be pre-existing before pregnancy, and while childbirth did not worsen pre-pregnancy PFD in most cases, cesarean section appeared to be more protective against postpartum worsening of pre-existing PFD compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean section seems to be more protective against postnatal worsening of prepregnancy PFD comparing to de novo onset pathology.
